rules.physics.title: World and physics rules
rules.physics.summary: Every physical interaction must remain consistent, readable, and stable across frame rates.
rules.physics.massGravityMomentum: Every world object must declare its physics role. Dynamic objects have mass, gravity, momentum, and colliders; static objects provide collision without unintended movement.
rules.physics.movementStates: Walking, running, jumping, falling, and landing use distinct motion responses.
rules.physics.massScaledImpacts: Pushed or kicked objects respond to applied impulse and mass, with bounded forces to prevent extreme launches.
rules.physics.noPenetration: K-09 must not pass through solid walls or furniture, hover without support, or move in place while blocked.
rules.physics.animationFollowsMotion: Procedural animation follows simulated velocity, ground contact, and landing state rather than overriding the authoritative physics pose.
rules.performance.title: Performance and stability
rules.performance.summary: Preserve simulation correctness while adapting rendering cost to the device.
rules.performance.targetFps: Aim for 60 FPS on capable devices; lower quality gracefully when needed on weaker devices.
rules.performance.fixedTimestep: Physics uses a fixed 60 Hz simulation step so behavior does not depend on rendering FPS.
rules.performance.distanceDetail: Reduce visual detail for distant objects when useful, without removing important gameplay collision.
rules.performance.sleepInactive: Inactive or sleeping objects should avoid expensive updates until they need them again.
rules.performance.noReloadLoop: Do not trigger unexpected page reloads or repeated loading screens during normal play.
rules.performance.recoverableErrors: Startup and runtime failures should provide useful error feedback and a safe recovery path without requiring an automatic page reload.

welcome.eyebrow: A LITTLE NOTE FROM YOUR SHELTER ANGEL
welcome.title: Welcome to the princess’s party!
welcome.message: Hello, welcome to the party, Princess! I’m Shelter Angel, your guide dog. Help me unlock the big present in the middle of the shelter by completing all the levels. Good luck!
welcome.objective: Complete the levels to unlock the big present
welcome.signature: Your little adventure starts here · Shelter Angel
levelOneGreeting.title: A Little Path, A New Story
levelOneGreeting.message: I am Shelter Angel, little guardian of Moss Garden. Follow the mossy stepping stones, awaken all three Paw Beacons, then let courage lead you to the FINISH plate. A little surprise is waiting there for our home.
levelTwoGreeting.eyebrow: LEVEL 2 · ACROSS THE SEA OF CLOUDS
levelTwoGreeting.title: Where the Sky Tests Your Steps
levelTwoGreeting.message: I am Azure Angel, keeper of the Cloudbreak route. Cross eleven floating islands, steady your paws on two Needle Beams, and watch for the wind-cutting rotors. Awaken all three Sky Beacons, then reach the Finish Crown. Let the wind challenge your steps, but let courage choose your way.
levelThreeGreeting.title: Between Timber and Courage
levelThreeGreeting.message: I am Ember Angel, keeper of the Timberfall trail. Cross the long wooden course, time your steps across five moving boards, and keep your balance on the narrow logs. Watch for the saws along the way, then awaken all three Timber Beacons before reaching the FINISH deck. A crate waits as an optional bonus challenge. With every landing, K-09 moves one step closer to the summit.
levelFourGreeting.title: When Violet Light Chooses the Way
levelFourGreeting.message: I am Vesper Angel, keeper of Violet Gyrofall. Climb the 8.7-metre route across three moving boards, then avoid three spinning holo-rotors. At both forks, choose a phase board while its brief foothold is still lit. Activate all three Ruin Beacons before reaching the Finish Deck. Read the rhythm of each rotation, and trust K-09’s next step.
levelFiveGreeting.gallery.title: Ughh... Don’t Disturb My Nap
levelFiveGreeting.gallery.message: Ughh... I really do not feel like explaining all this. I am Mallow Angel, keeper of the Memory Gallery, and I was supposed to be asleep by now. But fine, listen carefully: cross all nine Memory Cubes before each foothold collapses and returns. Then push the power crate onto the Pressure Switch and keep it there until the plate lights up. The TP Pad will only work after that. Do not jump blindly, do not leave the crate behind, and most importantly... do not wake me twice.
levelFiveGreeting.observatory.title: Made It This Far? Don’t Turn Back.
levelFiveGreeting.observatory.message: Ughh... you actually made it all the way here? Fine, listen just this once. Observatory X stretches across 135 metres: twenty zig-zag boards, two narrow balance bridges, a holographic rotor arena, slippery and temporary footholds, then three prism blocks leading to the FINISH deck. Find the checkpoints, study each moving section, and time your jumps instead of rushing. Conquer the whole route... then wake me up. I might have a reward. Maybe. But do not expect me to get out of bed to deliver it. I will point from right here. Now take a breath, watch every foothold, and prove K-09 deserves the title of Observatory Explorer.
levelFiveGreeting.observatory.hint: TAP TO BEGIN THE FINAL CHALLENGE

giftGreeting.eyebrow: SIX ANGEL VOICES · FOUR PAGES OF WISHES
giftGreeting.title: Happy Birthday, Yennhi!
giftGreeting.message: Yennhi, every level K-09 conquered and every obstacle you crossed together led to this gift. Inside is something no ribbon can hold: our warmest wishes for you. Happy Birthday! May you be blessed with good health, a peaceful heart, courage to follow your dreams, and kind people who walk beside you. When a day feels heavy, may strength find you; when happiness arrives, may your laughter stay a little longer. Keep growing, dreaming, and shining. Today, this little world of Paw Haven celebrates you.
giftGreeting.objective: A little wish tucked inside the biggest gift
giftGreeting.angel6.alt: Memory Angel, finder of the keepsake album
giftGreeting.slide1.speaker: SHELTER ANGEL · THE GENTLE HEART
giftGreeting.slide1.title: Happy Birthday, Yennhi!
giftGreeting.slide1.message: Happy birthday! May you always have a safe place to be yourself. You do not have to be perfect to deserve love. May good health watch over you, a peaceful heart walk beside you, and kind people stay near not only when life is easy, but also when the days feel heavy.
giftGreeting.slide2.speaker: AZURE ANGEL · KEEPER OF HOPE  ✦  FERN ANGEL · WISE COMPANION
giftGreeting.slide2.title: Keep Hope, and Be Kind to Yourself
giftGreeting.slide2.message:
Azure Angel, keeper of hope: When the road ahead is unclear, do not mistake uncertainty for being lost. Even one small step matters.

Fern Angel, the wise companion: Care for yourself as gently as you care for others. May you meet people who listen, respect your boundaries, and grow beside you without judgment.
giftGreeting.slide3.speaker: EMBER ANGEL · BEARER OF COURAGE  ✦  VESPER ANGEL · BRINGER OF JOY
giftGreeting.slide3.title: Grow Bravely, and Leave Room for Joy
giftGreeting.slide3.message:
Ember Angel, bearer of courage: May you find the courage to try, learn from what did not work, and begin again without shame.

Vesper Angel, bringer of joy: May your days hold honest laughter, warm friendships, and simple happiness that money cannot buy.
giftGreeting.slide4.speaker: MEMORY ANGEL · FINDER OF MEMORIES
giftGreeting.slide4.title: Wait, I Found Your Album!
giftGreeting.slide4.message: Wait a moment! I found your album! Look at these... every picture is so adorable. Now I wonder what you will be like when you are all grown up. May you open this album again someday with a smile, proud of how far you have come. May the future bring you good health, caring love, the chance to follow your dreams, and a new reason to be happy each day.
giftGreeting.slide4.objective: PAGE 4 · A MEMORY FOR THE FUTURE
giftGreeting.developerIntro.speaker: MEMORY ANGEL · A LITTLE LETTER FOR YOU
giftGreeting.developerIntro.title: Yennhi, There Is One More Message!
giftGreeting.developerIntro.message: Wait a moment, Yennhi! You have also received a special message from the developer who made this little adventure. They said this one should not be missed. Open it and read it slowly. There are some words meant just for you.
giftGreeting.developerIntro.objective: A PERSONAL LETTER IS WAITING TO BE READ
giftGreeting.letter.aria: A personal birthday letter from the developer
giftGreeting.letter.kicker: A LITTLE LETTER · WRITTEN WITH LOVE
giftGreeting.letter.title: For Yennhi, with all my heart
giftGreeting.letter.subtitle: One small message behind this big adventure.
giftGreeting.letter.scrollAria: Letter content. Scroll to the end.
giftGreeting.letter.signoffCaption: There is one thing I want to write myself...
giftGreeting.letter.endReached: YOU HAVE REACHED THE END OF THE LETTER
giftGreeting.letter.doneHint: THIS MESSAGE IS FOR YOU, YENNHI ♥
giftGreeting.letter.p1: Hello, my dear Yennhi... sweetheart... happy birthday to youuu..
giftGreeting.letter.p2: I made this game especially for your birthday. So, is it fun? I made every level, surprise, and little page hoping it would bring a smile to your face while you play. I wanted this gift to feel like a small adventure prepared just for you.
giftGreeting.letter.p3: Thank you for coming into my life in such a kind way. You are not only someone I love, but also a place where my heart feels calm after a long day. The simple moments with you often make an ordinary day feel warmer and lighter.
giftGreeting.letter.p4: I am proud of you, including the little efforts you may sometimes think are ordinary. May this new year of your life bring more happiness, good health, honest prosperity, a peaceful heart, and new reasons to smile. May every step ahead carry meaning, even when the road is not always easy.
giftGreeting.letter.p5: The more I get to know you, the more I understand that love is not only about the moments when everything feels wonderful. Love is also learning to understand each other, listen, make room for one another, and keep growing together when a day is difficult. Thank you for growing and walking beside me.
giftGreeting.letter.p6: I want to keep being by your side, not only when everything is beautiful, but also when you have doubts or need someone who believes in you. May you always find the courage to follow your dreams, meet sincere people, and never feel that you must make yourself smaller to be accepted. You deserve a love that cares for you as deeply as you care for others.
giftGreeting.letter.p7: I may not always be good at writing sweet words or showing everything perfectly. But there is one thing I want you to know: I am truly grateful to have you. I want to keep learning how to care for you well, make more memories, and celebrate many birthdays together in the years ahead. Enjoy your day, sweetheart. You deserve to be celebrated.
